info.description:
## Comprehensive automated basic functionality test suite for WSO2 API Manager 4.x.x.

**Run Order:** 00 → 12 using Collection Runner.  
**Prerequisites:** Set control_plane_hostname, gateway_hostname, admin_username, admin_password in environment.  
**Note:** editable_api_id, editable_api_context, editable_api_version, editable_api_get_operation must point to an existing published API.
